meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: Claude 会先把任务注册成目标,再拆成一条条超细步骤,每步只做一件事并同步到实时清单;是否完成由真实表面采集到的证据判定,长任务会留下检查点,中断后可续做。
howto.when: 当你提到 “ulw-loop”“ulw” 等关键词,或要求持久的目标执行、带检查点的长时交付、人工 QA 等场景时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这个任务拆成一步步执行
say.note: 先按参考文档注册目标,再逐步推进

say.text: 看看当前 ulw-loop 的目标、清单和状态
say.note: 读取目标、实时清单与运行状态

say.text: 中断了,接着上次的检查点继续
say.note: 先重读任务简报、目标与账本再恢复

howto.what_en: Claude registers the task as a goal, breaks it into ultra-granular steps mirrored into a live checklist, and judges done only by evidence from a real surface. Long runs leave checkpoints to resume.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop or ulw, durable goal execution, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Run this task as an ulw-loop, step by step
say_en.note: Registers goals first, then works the steps

say_en.text: Show the current ulw-loop goals, checklist and status
say_en.note: Reads goals, live checklist and state
